issue: No field↔placeholder consistency validation; previews contain unresolved placeholders
actual: Submitted a template whose content had {{owner}}, {{yesterday}}, {{today}} but whose only declared field was "Blocker" (no {{blocker}} in content). Submission succeeded ("Template submitted!"). Using it, the generated preview literally reads "Owner: {{owner}} ... {{yesterday}} ... {{today}}" — unresolved placeholders.

issue: Duplicate field labels neither rejected nor disambiguated; fields not independently fillable
actual: Adding two fields both labelled "Name" was accepted (both shown as key {{name}}) and the template submitted successfully. In its fill form both inputs share data-semtag-id preview.fields.item.name; entering "Alice" in the first made both read "Alice". React also logged duplicate-key errors in the console.

evidence: After reloading http://localhost:7089/: 8 templates including both custom ones (Daily Standup Note, Dup Field Test); favorites badge still 2 with items 1 and 3 marked on.
